label: Oracle and keeper
summary: Define attributable external data and automation with bounded freshness and failure behavior.
requiredFacts: Data origin, units, decimals, update cadence and maximum staleness
Keeper trigger, authority, incentives, idempotency and rate limits
Manipulation, fallback, pause-free failure and recovery behavior
Who can replace the oracle or keeper and with what delay
requiredTests: Stale, zero, negative, extreme and malformed data
Missed, duplicate, reordered and adversarial keeper calls
risks: Stale or manipulable data can move value incorrectly
Keeper liveness can become a hidden user-exit dependency
Mutable dependency authority can rewrite economics
